(Copyright 2024 by KPRC Click2Houston - All rights reserved.)​Easter Sunday in 2025 falls on April 20, and many retailers in the Houston area adjust their schedules for the holiday. Here’s a guide to help you plan your shopping:​Stores Closed on Easter Sunday 2025Recommended VideosSeveral major retailers will be closed to allow employees time with their families:​TargetMacy’sAldiKohl’sLowe’sMarshallsTJ MaxxHomeGoodsCostcoSam’s ClubJCPenneyH-E-BBest BuyMichaelsStaplesThe UPS Store​Stores Open on Easter Sunday 2025If you need to pick up last-minute items, these stores will be open, though hours may vary:​WalmartTrader Joe’sHome DepotPetcoPetSmartAlbertsons/SafewayWhole Foods (​closing at 6 p.m)Kroger-owned storesCVS (​some with reduced hours)Walgreens (​some may have reduced hours)Ace HardwareBarnes & Noble (​11:00 p.m.– 7:00 p.m)Big Lots!Cabela’sSprouts​It’s advisable to check with your local store for specific hours, as they may vary by location.Copyright 2025 by KPRC Click2Houston - All rights reserved.Storms are heading towards Houston this Saturday!▶ 1:21Storms are heading towards Houston this Saturday!Houston, we have a DEAL!
